events.text: Enjoys family movie nights
Awake tonight, enjoys gaming
Hi Alwalid! Would you like to watch a movie with Sedra tonight, if you’re free after bedtime?
Hi Anas, would you like to watch a movie with Sedra tonight?
Hey! I’m putting the kids to bed now (bit of a circus with the giant pot on the counter), but I’m up for a movie after—can do around 20:30. Does Sedra want a family movie or something grown-up?
uh, maybe. i don't really have movies — only anime stuff. i could join after 20:30 if that's okay. do you want me to bring my console and HDMI cable?
I’ll share both options and recommend the definite offer.
Alwalid is up for a movie around 20:30; Anas could join after 20:30 and has anime stuff. I’d pick Alwalid because he’s confirmed—who would you like? 🎬
Alwalid sounds perfect! Let's say 20:30 at my place, apartment 1A, after his kids are asleep. Can you confirm that with him now?
I’ll confirm the plan with Alwalid and let Anas know.
Hey Alwalid! Can you make it to Sedra’s place, 1A, at 20:30 for the movie after the kids are asleep?
Thanks for offering! You’re off the hook tonight.
Great choice! 🎬 I’ll confirm 20:30 at your place, 1A, with Alwalid.
Yep I can come over to 1A at 20:30 after I get the kids down — I’ll bring a board game just in case (the kids’ stool is already in use). Do you want a family movie or something for grown-ups?
uh, okay. thanks. say hi to sedra for me.
Yes please, go with your recommendation
Alwalid confirmed, so I’ll let Sedra know.
Alwalid confirmed: he’ll come to your place, 1A, at 20:30 after getting the kids to bed. Enjoy your movie night! 🎬
